## Open Experimental Hypotheses (`EXP`)

| ID | Title | Testable Hypothesis | Risk / Gamification Guardrail | Owners | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **EXP-001** | **Queen Receiver-Only Praise vs. Nepotism Stress-Test** | Keep ratings private, cap roommate loops, and let Queens praise only learner success (tracing backward to tutors) across Honest vs. Biased simulation arms. | Nepotism (Queens disproportionately praising favored students) and gamification side-effects are untested empirically; weights stay unlocked until simulated. | `ux-behavior-agent`, `sci-research-agent` | `open-simulation` |
| **EXP-002** | **15-Week Finals Crunch & Waggle 60% Co-Pay Fill Rate** | Pairing ~2%/mo Weeks 1-13 demurrage with 60% Comb Waggle co-pay on 2.2x peak tutor payouts lifts 15-week semester fill rate from ~38% (fixed scrip) to >=65%. | Over-aggressive demurrage or under-funded Comb buffers could deplete reserves before Finals Week 14 if midterm surges exceed 4.0x baseline. | `ux-behavior-agent`, `product-lifecycle-agent` | `open-simulation` |
| **EXP-003** | **Pairwise Discoordination + COCM Dorm-Cluster Sybil Bound** | Combining pairwise decay (alpha=1.5), EigenTrust anchors, and COCM Fiedler-vector dorm-SBT clustering caps m-node colluder rings below C(m,2)*k extraction. | Over-penalizing shared dorm/major SBTs could unintentionally discount legitimate study groups in small upper-division departments. | `sci-research-agent`, `contracts-service-agent` | `open-simulation` |
| **EXP-004** | **Khoury Mortality Bifurcation & EO Promotion Circuit Breaker** | Clamping Nurse-Tutor outbound promotion when Scout attrition approaches mu_crit prevents precocious foraging collapse and preserves >=85% freshman retention. | Hard promotion clamps during prolonged cross-Hive demand shocks may temporarily slow outbound cross-campus pollination. | `sci-research-agent`, `ux-behavior-agent` | `open-simulation` |
| **EXP-005** | **Asymmetric Campus NAT Partition & NATS JetStream Recovery** | Outbound NATS Leaf Node JetStream mirrors recover 100% of AcceptedStatusGranted proofs after 30-minute Pumba/Toxiproxy WAN partitions with zero double-minting. | Long WAN partitions exceeding Prometheus 30m out-of-order windows require replay deduplication and epoch FX snapshot pinning. | `system-arch-agent`, `contracts-service-agent` | `open-simulation` |
| **EXP-006** | **Mesa Baseline vs. External n8n Hybrid Trigger Arm** | Compare deterministic seeded Mesa ABM + ML/RL runs against external n8n/Activepieces webhook-triggered surge and Sybil arms on seed parity, latency, and collusion detection. | External LLM/webhook timing adds non-determinism and SUL license risk; keep triggers off-chain and replayable via logged inputs. | `ux-behavior-agent`, `contracts-service-agent` | `open-simulation` |

## Tooling & Code-Level Controls

- **Add/update fast decisions:** Edit `docs/planning/decisions.yaml` or run `uv run nectr-decisions add-decision ...`, then `uv run nectr-decisions render`.
- **Propose/accept MADR architecture records:** Run `uv run adrlint new "<Title>"`, promote `status: accepted` in YAML front matter, and run `uv run adrlint lock` (`<= 70` lines, `<= 380` words).
- **Verify all governance gates:** Run `uv run nectr-decisions check` (use `--allow-proposed` on WIP feature branches).
